[h1]UFO's Cheat Mods Bundle [1.5.3] - No War Sails[/h1]
Mod v1.0.19 for Bannerlord v1.5.3 only. Older game versions, including v1.5.0–v1.5.2, and future releases are unsupported. War Sails / NavalDLC is not required or referenced. Naval cheats are omitted.
[h1]What this mod includes[/h1] A configurable cheat bundle with character and troop progression, automatic perk selection, combat cheats, campaign economy and map settings, hotkeys, and bundled weapons and ammunition. Naval controls are not included in this edition.
[b]Enable only one UFO edition.[/b] This item has a new module identity. Older saves can display a module mismatch; back up a save before changing editions. Existing 1.4.8 items remain available separately.
[h1]Dependencies[/h1] Harmony 2.4.2+, ButterLib 2.11.1+, UIExtenderEx 2.13.2+, and Mod Configuration Menu v5 5.12.3+. Install dependency releases compatible with your game.
[h1]Testing status[/h1] Eight static edition/reference audits, seven auditor self-tests and 200 maintained regression checks per edition passed. Live v1.5.3 IL was checked. Historical IL and gameplay were not verified; older versions are excluded. Final builds passed; playtesting was confirmed by the publishing user on 2026-10-04. Recorded results are in the maintained source. Report bugs with your game/DLC versions, the action and setting, and a crash ID or report link.
[h1]Credits[/h1] All original work and bundle credit belongs to UFOdestiny and the original authors. This is a compatibility and maintenance build by Arcayon.
